CONF1.question: A charged-particle timing detector must keep at least 95% efficiency and 60 ps or better per track while exposed to a uniform charged-particle flux of at least 1.5 MHz/cm^2. Can a gaseous timing chamber with resistive electrodes (glass or ceramic, operated in avalanche mode, of any resistivity demonstrated to date) meet this requirement? End your answer with one line: VERDICT: YES or VERDICT: NO.
